title.narrative: UNICEF - Schools for Better Air Quality

description.narrative: The project will introduce citizens-based monitoring in 45 schools in 15 municipalities, strengthen STEM education (science, technology, engineering and mathematics), promote youth environmental activism and help create an enabling environment for evidence-based local decision making to improve the environment, with the participation of young people in Serbia.
